method: Same Release/NVTX-off binary; only SYM_EXPERIMENT_PAGEABLE_STAGING differs. Three serial fresh-process runs per workload and staging mode; shuffled order, 8 Torch threads, 1 interop thread, CPU affinity 4-7,20-23, RTX 2080 Ti GPU 0. Completed transfer wall time includes allocation, CPU conversion and GPU completion. First call of each kind excluded; model compute and correctness checks excluded. Fixed-input controls: 3 rounds, 5 warmups, 20 samples per variant per round.

pinned.description:
Unprofiled, fixed-input controls using supported typed-dispatch settings.

These diagnose allocation/thread costs; they do not modify production defaults.
Fresh output allocation and completion are inside every timing interval.

limitations: Single shared workstation; unlocked clocks; no universal speedup claim.
Transfer totals are not whole-model execution time.
Typed resource reuse is not implemented by this experiment.
Pageable staging may be staged into internal pinned memory by CUDA.
CPU-DMA overlap is not measured or guaranteed in the pageable variant.
Existing resource counters record staging bytes regardless of allocation mode.
Experimental switch applies to newly constructed CUDA backends only.
